winner.text: Add impression-time request-context features tab, hour, and weekday to the neutral user/item additive model.
winner.rationale: This directly tests the only screened feature family with positive primary lift. The measured screening lift was +0.002213 with full coverage, and warm-user/item GAUC was 0.6312, but nDCG@5 was only 0.5076, so the expected benefit is larger for ordering than top-five concentration.
winner.exact_ablation: Ablate the neutral ID-only input by adding only impression-time tab, hour, and weekday fields; keep the additive architecture, BCE loss, optimizer, and training schedule unchanged.

expected_effect.GAUC: Increase by approximately +0.002 to +0.004, supported by the measured +0.002213 primary lift and warm-user/item GAUC of 0.6312.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Increase by approximately +0.0005 to +0.0025; the gain may be smaller than GAUC because screened nDCG@5 was 0.5076.

selection_rationale: Select c01 because it has the strongest measured evidence: request-context features are the only screened family with positive primary lift (+0.002213), full coverage, and positive daily lifts on all evaluated dates. It offers the best expected gain-to-risk tradeoff with an estimated +0.0023 primary improvement, high confidence, low leakage risk, low runtime risk, and a clean single-family ablation. The Consultant ranked it first ahead of more speculative loss, architecture, and sequential alternatives.
